jsonld.name: AnyLopez Lifting & Anti-Ageing
jsonld.description: Catalogue of non-surgical lifting and anti-ageing treatments at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm: Ultherapy HIFU and INDIBA radiofrequency. Deep collagen and elastin stimulation, no surgery, no downtime.

faq.q: Ultherapy HIFU or INDIBA Radiofrequency — which one to choose?
faq.a: It depends. HIFU is a shock treatment (1-2 sessions, results at 3-6 months). INDIBA Radiofrequency is progressive (10-session package, results from the 1st session). HIFU suits moderate-to-significant laxity. INDIBA Radiofrequency suits maintenance and gradual firming. We confirm the right choice during your consultation.

faq.q: How many Ultherapy HIFU sessions do I need?
faq.a: 1-2 sessions depending on the area and degree of laxity. Sessions are spaced 6-12 months apart for maintenance. INDIBA Radiofrequency is a 10-session package run on a weekly cadence.

faq.q: How long do the results last?
faq.a: Ultherapy: 12-18 months once the full effect develops at 3-6 months. INDIBA Radiofrequency: long-lasting effect with monthly maintenance after the package.

faq.q: At what age should I start?
faq.a: When you notice loss of firmness in the jawline, typically from 35-45 years onward. Better sooner than later: stimulating collagen works best while you still have reserves.
Minimal: topical hydration, strict sun protection over the following days, avoid saunas/extreme heat for 48h. We hand you written guidance after every session.

why.eyebrow: Why non-surgical lifting at AnyLopez works
why.h2_html: Six reasons it works here where it doesn't elsewhere.
why.p: Not marketing. Deep technology, clinical judgement and decades of craft.

items.p: Ultherapy HIFU works at the SMAS layer (the same layer a surgeon cuts to perform a lifting). INDIBA radiofrequency at 448 kHz penetrates down to the hypodermis. Each targets different layers.
If your case calls for it, we combine Ultherapy HIFU + INDIBA Radiofrequency in a sequenced plan. Not a sales pitch — a clinical protocol.

items.h3: No surgery, no anaesthesia, no downtime
items.p: You walk out and carry on with your life. No marks, no medication, no month indoors.
Not instant magic. We stimulate your own collagen and elastin, which take 3-6 months to reach full effect and last 12-18 months.
We tell you which one (or both) is right for you. If your case truly needs injectables or surgery instead, we tell you that too.

items.h3: Performed by the person signing off the result
items.p: Decades with this technology. Knows where to insist and where to ease off in each case.

process.h2: Four steps. No surprises, no small print.
process.p: From your first message to seeing the first improvement is less than two weeks.

steps.p_html: Call/WhatsApp to find a slot. 30 minutes at the clinic, no cost, no commitment.

We assess area, degree of laxity, skin quality and goal. We decide whether your case is Ultherapy HIFU, INDIBA Radiofrequency, both combined, or whether — given its features — another solution would suit you better.

steps.h3: Personalised Ultherapy HIFU / INDIBA Radiofrequency / combined plan
steps.p_html: You don't just "come in for a session". We design the protocol: number of sessions, cadence, what to combine and why. And if your case can be resolved with less than expected, we say so.

steps.h3: Follow-up over the months after the session
steps.p_html: Ultherapy HIFU's result is progressive: not visible today, visible at 3-6 months. Direct WhatsApp for questions, adjustments and guidance until you see the final effect.
